svg.title: FOCER-v2 object-conditioned exposure routing architecture
svg.desc: Paper-style comparison of the original fixed-exposure detector baseline with FOCER-v2 inference and its training-only teacher supervision.

g.text: Each object query chooses its own useful exposure evidence.
(c) Training-only guidance for learning meaningful routes
TRAINING ONLY - the teacher and labels are removed at inference
The teacher supplies exposure-selection knowledge; ordinary detection losses preserve the end task.
Core difference: the baseline fuses predicted boxes; FOCER-v2 lets each object query route and fuse exposure evidence before making one prediction.
